title: Resident Accounts Standard for the Entrance Fee Agreement Refundable Amount and Deductions After Termination
content:
After termination of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** the refundable amount is the refundable balance: the entrance fee received less the administrative retention and every amortization booked through the termination date.

## Deductions, in their order
From the refundable amount are deducted, each as its own entry:

1. first, every unpaid charge on the customer's Larkspur independent living, assisted living or memory care residency at the campus, applied to those charges oldest first and referencing each charge entry. The unpaid charges are the positive balance of those residencies as of the handling date, each traced to the unpaid charge entries that make it up. Each amount applied is received on that residency account as a payment by entrance refund offset;
2. then the cost of refurbishment beyond normal wear and tear documented by a maintenance work order, the work order number entered exactly as printed.

## Refurbishment cap
Refurbishment deductions in total may not exceed the plan's refurbishment deduction cap percentage of the entrance fee, rounded to the cent half up. The room left for a further refurbishment deduction is that cap amount less the refurbishment already deducted on the agreement.

## Timing and status
The written refund calculation statement is issued and the refund scheduled no later than the plan's refund calculation statement period, in calendar days, after the termination date, and deductions may be recorded only while the agreement is in terminated status.

## Once only
Each residency charge entry is offset at most once.

## Nothing left
Where nothing remains refundable after deductions the agreement is closed without a refund.

## Worked example (hypothetical agreement, a 5 percent cap)
Entrance fee 400000.00; refundable balance at termination 180000.00. Unpaid independent living charges of 2100.00 (older) and 950.00 (newer) are offset first, each as its own entry, leaving 176950.00. The cap amount is 20000.00; with 4000.00 already deducted for one work order, a second work order may deduct up to 16000.00.

## Status check
| Agreement status | Offsets and refurbishment deductions may be recorded |
|---|---|
| Terminated | Yes |
| Any other status | No |
